items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: And Marva Louis, I arranged all her music

ctx.x: She was the lady that married Joe Louis, right?
Yeah, Marva Louis. She used to get $500 a performance. She went down to Philadelphia, and it was a small
room, and then people would try to tear her clothes off. But she went through with it. She made a bet with Joe, I think, or somebody, that she could last six months in show business. And she did.
